lines.zh: 咔哒咔哒，我的小腿踩过石头。
lines.en: Click-click, my little legs cross the stone.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着末影的沙沙声。
lines.en: Every step rustles with ender dust.

lines.zh: 我沿着珍珠滚过的痕迹爬。
lines.en: I crawl along the trail the pearl rolled.
Don't step on me, I am on my way.

lines.zh: 六条腿一起跑，谁也追不上。
lines.en: Six legs at once, no one keeps up.

lines.zh: 紫色碎屑从我背上掉下来。
lines.en: Purple crumbs fall off my back.
The ground shakes because I crawl.
I need a dark crack to crawl into.

lines.zh: 珍珠的味道还留在土里。
lines.en: The pearl's scent still clings to the dirt.

lines.zh: 爬过苔石，爬过你的靴子。
lines.en: Over mossy stone, over your boot.

lines.zh: 我的壳比看上去硬得多。
lines.en: My shell is much harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 沙沙沙，这声音是我发的。
lines.en: Rustle, rustle, that sound is me.
Who threw that pearl so very far.

lines.zh: 我一路啃着石头过来的。
lines.en: I chewed my way through all this stone.

lines.zh: 我顺着沙粒滚落的方向爬。
lines.en: I crawl the way the grains of sand rolled.
If the crack is narrow enough, I slip in.
Quiet, let me grind my teeth.
I am less than a day old.
The pearl shell cracked inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 末影人闻到我就会发狂。
lines.en: Endermen go mad when they smell me.
I count my legs: six of them.
This place is too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 有人在石头外面走动吗。
lines.en: Is someone walking outside the stone.
I shake myself and purple dust falls.
Small as I am, I can bite iron.
I am hungry, sleepy, and short-lived.
The crack in the stone is cool and safe.
When I grow up — in truth, I never do.
You stepped on a pearl, didn't you.
Big one, look down at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的靴子闻起来像末地。
lines.en: Your boots smell of the End.
I remember the hand that threw the pearl.
Don't pretend you cannot see me.
There is purple light in your eyes.
I am going to bite your ankle.
You smell of burnt teleport.
You again, owner of the pearl.
I have chosen you, do not turn away.
Are you going to squash me flat.
Looking up won't help, I am below.
Crack! My shell split.
You dare step on me? Then I bite.
Ow, ow, my legs.
I will carve this blow into my shell.

lines.zh: 我这么小你也下得去手。
lines.en: I am this small and you still hit me.
Not the sword, use your sole.
My purple dust flew right out.
One more hit and I come apart.
You interrupted my crawl.
I will bite back, I swear.
That pearl, give it to me.
One purple glint and my legs stop.
That is the smell of an ender pearl.
Throw it here, I can catch it.
Will you trade a pearl for your life.
I follow the glow, always following.
The one in the water is mine too.
Don't put it away, I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 珍珠落地的地方就有我。
lines.en: Where a pearl lands, there I am.
Throw another one, just one more.
I won't eat it, I only want to guard it.
That glow makes my teeth itch.
Hey, your foot is far too big.
Bump me once and you get bitten.
I got squeezed into the stone crack.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到我的壳了。
lines.en: Your boot tip touched my shell.
Small as I am, I take up space.
You kicked me, apologize.
My shell is cracking under the pressure.
Back off, my teeth are in front.
Stop shoving, crawl in line.
You knocked me back to the pearl.

lines.zh: 另一只螨在石头下等我。
lines.en: Another mite waits beneath the stone.
We speak by tapping our shells.
Two mites, one crack, enough.
I hide my eggs under the mossy stone.
Your shell-tap sounds lovely.
Don't steal her, she is mine.
A pile of pearls is best for laying eggs.
We don't live long, hurry.
She touched me with her antennae.

lines.zh: 下一代也会从珍珠里爬出。
lines.en: The next brood will crawl from pearls too.
This pearl belongs to me now.
I drag it along with my teeth.
Shiny things go under my shell.
You dropped it, I picked it up.
This amethyst shard is really heavy.
I can carry it, don't underestimate me.
Hide it in the crack, no one will find it.
A piece of end stone, perfect for my nest.

lines.zh: 谁掉的面包屑，也是我的。
lines.en: Whose crumb is this? Also mine.
My collection outlives me.
You crushed the pearl shell.
Target locked: your foot.
I smell the warmth of something alive.
I start biting from your shadow.
Don't run, I crawl faster than you.
The pearl delivered me to you.
Your blood is sweet, I guess.
I pick you because you are the biggest.
Endermen taught me what to hate.
One bite keeps me alive a day.
The pearl in your hand is burning hot.
Here I come, don't blink.
Click, click, getting closer.
I circle around your boots.
You step back, I step forward.
I am looking for your ankle.
Don't look down, I will leap up.
My teeth are already open.
Did you hear that rustling sound.
The stone rings under my feet.
I wait for your foot to land.
You are breathing hard, good.
The pearl's glow is on you.
Three, two, one, bite.
I have got your ankle now.
This bite carries the chill of the End.
Does it hurt? I want another bite.
My teeth are tiny but many.
You jumped, how fun.
Shell to shell, me to you.
One bite, then half a step back.
Your leggings cannot stop me.

lines.zh: 我咬的是珍珠留下的印。
lines.en: I bite the mark the pearl left.
Don't swat me, I get worse.
The pearl cracked, here I am.
Crawling out of the purple smoke.

lines.zh: 落地那一刻我就出生了。
lines.en: I was born the moment it landed.

lines.zh: 二十分之一的机会，是我。
lines.en: One chance in twenty, and it was me.
Whoever threw the pearl is responsible.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气是末影味。
lines.en: My first breath tasted of the End.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，牙已经硬了。
lines.en: My shell is soft, my teeth are hard.
So bright, this world is so bright.
I poke my head out of the crack.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，我就是来了。
lines.en: Don't ask where I came from, I am here.
Fire? I fear light, and heat more.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，壳都扁了。
lines.en: Dropped from that height, my shell is flat.
Water is in my shell cracks, cough.
The blast rolled me three times.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边，差一点。
lines.en: An arrow pinned the ground beside me, almost.
That potion smell makes me dizzy.
I am so hungry I chew my own shell.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我的眼睛烧了。
lines.en: The lightning is too bright, my eyes burn.
Below is nothing, I cannot hold on.
